0x61b1e40.name: rocksdb::Tracer::Get
quirks: On the skip path Get returns Status::OK() without consulting the clock: a flagged or oversized get leaves the clock's call count at 0 and the sampling counter untouched (flag skips) -- the gate runs before the timestamp is read.

The type byte lives in its own stack slot (rsp+0x13) passed by address to ShouldSkipTrace, then copied into trace.type at rsp+0x28 after the gate passes; ShouldSkipTrace reads the type through that pointer (movzbl 0x0(%rbp) at 0x61b1949).

The varint length prefix encodes the LOW 32 bits of the key size (mov 0x8(%r12),%esi -- a 32-bit load -- before EncodeVarint32) while the append copies the full size_t -- a >4 GiB key would prefix the truncated length; untestable at that scale, recorded from the disassembly.
The payload_map bits (kGetCFID = 2, kGetKey = 3; map becomes 12) are never serialized by EncodeTrace; they are visible only as the first 8 payload bytes (PutFixed64).

The timestamp comes from the 13-layer SystemClockWrapper::NowMicros fast path (each layer's vtable slot 19 compared against 0x5d4d490, followed through +0x20); the first layer whose slot differs calls that slot's function directly instead of continuing the chain.
The CF id is read through the ColumnFamilyHandle vtable slot 3 (0x18) -- GetID() -- and stored little-endian as 4 bytes; it is NOT varint-encoded.

The exception landing pad at 0x61b21be..0x61b21c5 jumps to the shared pad at 0x61b1e18..0x61b1e3d (_M_dispose + _Unwind_Resume) and runs only on the exception path (bad_alloc from the string appends); the string length guards raise length_error instead (std::string::_M_append, via __throw_length_error).

The payload string is freed only when its pointer differs from the SSO buffer at rsp+0x48 (standard string destruction); the 5-byte varint buffer sits at rsp+0x63, just below the stack canary at rsp+0x68.
rules: if ShouldSkipTrace(this, type) (0x61b1930) returns true, return Status::OK() at once (no clock call, no writer call)
trace.ts = clock_->NowMicros() via the 13-layer SystemClockWrapper::NowMicros (0x5d4d490) fast path (vtable slot 19, +0x20 per layer); a layer whose slot differs calls that slot's function directly
TracerHelper::SetPayloadMap(trace.payload_map, 2) (0x61b18b0): bts bit 2 (kGetCFID), then SetPayloadMap(trace.payload_map, 3): bts bit 3 (kGetKey), so the in-memory payload_map becomes 12
PutFixed64(&trace.payload, trace.payload_map): append the 8 little-endian bytes of the map (0c 00 00 00 00 00 00 00), with the std::string length guard
PutFixed32(&trace.payload, column_family->GetID()): the CF id via the ColumnFamilyHandle vtable slot 3 (0x18), appended as 4 little-endian bytes, with the std::string length guard

PutLengthPrefixedSlice(&trace.payload, key): EncodeVarint32((uint32_t)key_size) into a 5-byte stack buffer, append the varint bytes, then append the key bytes ([key+0x00], [key+0x08] bytes), each append with the std::string length guard
return WriteTrace(trace) (0x61b1a10): EncodeTrace + TraceWriter::Write (slot 2); the returned Status is forwarded unchanged
